name: REFALL AB
tagline: Persistent research loops. Bounded work. Reviewable evidence.
summary: REFALL AB makes a research campaign persistent across worker conversations and manager sessions. Shared coverage, evidence, obligations, scoped launch decisions, and checked closeout connect bounded work to reviewable conclusions.

features.title: Persistent subject workbenches
features.description: Keep context, coverage, evidence, decisions, and reports together for each subject.
features.mechanism: Workbench metadata, SQLite records, JSONL ledger entries, runtime artifacts, and the current report pointer share one subject identity.

features.title: Context before execution
features.description: Give specialists a shared briefing before the loop starts.
features.mechanism: The context writer compiles selected material. The backend stores the result and refuses startup without nonempty context.

features.title: Readiness and work estimates
features.description: Inspect execution prerequisites and remaining work before using specialist capacity.
features.mechanism: Doctor checks services and resources. Estimate combines inventory, coverage, pending actions, and readiness.

features.title: Content identity and measured coverage
features.description: Know which files exist and which examination units have recorded results.
features.mechanism: Streaming hashes identify content. Coverage units carry leases, summaries, sensitivity, data touched, flows, leads, and evidence.

features.title: Modules with local dependencies
features.description: Combine breadth, decomposition, review, verification, research, and development within one subject.
features.mechanism: Subject, finding, and later unit selection apply dependencies and module limits. Later unit passes also apply recorded-path filters. Fresh characterization uses coverage claims and global concurrency.

features.title: Subject-specific research without a new driver
features.description: Add or adjust bounded passes through workbench configuration.
features.mechanism: The refall_modules field selects packs and custom declarations. The registry resolves dependencies; scheduler branches apply their corresponding selection checks.

features.title: Breadth before repeated depth
features.description: Keep an initial component subset from consuming the whole campaign.
features.mechanism: Pending actions and subject tasks run first. Fresh units precede finding tasks and later unit passes.

features.title: Specialist provider routing
features.description: Assign interpretation, implementation, review, and verification to configured providers.
features.mechanism: Task classes supply routing rationale. Subject lane patterns balance active slots. Optional Grok work remains host-managed.

features.title: Evidence appears during the run
features.description: Preserve observations from agent messages, structured files, and saved analysis.
features.mechanism: Polling reads the conversation event stream and workspace. Incremental and terminal ingestion share stable identities.

features.title: Research survives incomplete workers
features.description: Keep useful facts and artifacts when a worker stops without a clean result.
features.mechanism: Terminal handling classifies and parses the invocation, checks submission identity, and preserves observations before handling the classified outcome. Failed assignments remain pending.

features.title: Durable output before module completion
features.description: Prevent an empty subject pass from becoming a progress marker.
features.mechanism: Missing canonical observations or failed persistence creates an ingestion-review action and blocks that module completion.

features.title: Typed result contracts
features.description: Separate research results, finding proposals, evidence updates, and control requests.
features.mechanism: The refall.submit.v1 parser validates metadata, confidence, limitations, and locations. Strict mode preserves malformed output as unfinished work.

features.title: Evidence-backed candidate acceptance
features.description: Check a finding against available source identity and explicit scope.
features.mechanism: Promotion checks evidence, confidence, inventory membership, external hosts, and material supporting claimed validation.

features.title: Finding state and proof strength stay separate
features.description: Distinguish a workflow decision from the quality of its evidence.
features.mechanism: Six lifecycle states coexist with hypothesis, code-confirmed, and live-confirmed tiers. Valid promotion requires a live reproduction receipt.

features.title: Negative conclusions need receipts
features.description: Preserve the reason for rejection, duplicates, deferral, and downgrade.
features.mechanism: Typed transition rules check supporting references, current state, pending obligations, and source freshness. Accepted and refused attempts remain stored.

features.title: Scoped action authorization
features.description: Give operator grants a class, target scope, expiry, and conditions.
features.mechanism: The broker checks applicable host, port, method, path, and effect conditions for presented requests. Backend launch obeys refusal. Grant authentication requires the configured operator token.

features.title: Persistent obligations
features.description: Make missing access, blocked scope, incomplete proof, and failed output visible.
features.mechanism: Pending actions carry source references, priority, ownership, status, and required receipts. The scheduler considers them before ordinary coverage.

features.title: Continuity across sessions
features.description: Resume a campaign from subject state rather than a conversation summary.
features.mechanism: Loop state, module progress, blackboard notes, manifests, and checkpoints preserve execution context and input identities.

features.title: Archive before cleanup
features.description: Retain trajectories and event streams before retiring completed conversations.
features.mechanism: The loop creates durable artifacts and records archive or cleanup failures. Conversation lifetime is separate from evidence lifetime.

features.title: Supervision for long campaigns
features.description: Observe progress and recover a failed service within explicit policy.
features.mechanism: Watchdog and supervisor passes examine liveness, failures, budgets, relevance, and evidence flow. Repeated recovery can produce an operator hold.

features.title: Living reports and analyst notes
features.description: Compile architecture, findings, flows, proof, and unanswered questions while research continues.
features.mechanism: Report scheduling uses new evidence or a reserved slot. Analyst notes remain separate from the formal deliverable.

features.title: Preserve accumulated report detail
features.description: Protect populated technical sections from a thinner replacement.
features.mechanism: Draft and assembly paths compare structure. A refused candidate can be retained for inspection while the richer report stays current.

features.title: Checked closeout
features.description: Show the exact completion barriers and advisory warnings.
features.mechanism: The gate checks obligations, proof, receipts, context, leases, and report freshness. Explicit overrides remain evidence records.

features.title: Compiled-binary research family
features.description: Move from import callers to independent review and runtime proof.
features.mechanism: Standalone compatibility drivers seed function investigations, decompile and branch, challenge reachability, and compile reproduction artifacts.

features.title: Optional analysis resources
features.description: Use semantic tools, symbol indexes, graphs, metrics, and focused property-graph analysis.
features.mechanism: The installable toolchain supplies source analysis and managed MCP services. Subject tasks select the resources they need.

features.title: Research ledger and Output view
features.description: Facts, leads, findings, validation, and operator decisions remain with the subject after individual conversations end.
features.mechanism: An append-only JSONL ledger supplies filtered queries, statistics, the Ops Output projection, and report inputs. Finding and authority APIs manage their separate state transitions.

features.title: Wishlist fulfillment and delivered-resource briefing
features.description: Missing tools and other research resources become explicit requests with recorded delivery.
features.mechanism: The watchdog checks host executables, optionally runs allowlisted installers, and appends provided rows and ledger receipts. Head cycles and research-driver startup snapshots carry delivered items into their own worker objectives.

features.title: Campaign cycles and target-specific passes
features.description: A coordinator cycle, a module pass, a worker retry, and report or supervision review have distinct state and completion conditions.
features.mechanism: Pending actions preempt setup, fresh breadth, finding work, and later unit work. Target-local dependencies and completion records govern module eligibility. Coordinator limits preserve active work for continuation.

flows.title: The campaign cycle
flows.summary: One coordinator pass selects work, polls conversations, retains evidence, refreshes records, and saves continuation state. A dashed return represents another eligible coordinator cycle.

nodes.title: Select recorded work
nodes.role: Claim worker-eligible pending actions first. Then consider threat-model or subject setup, fresh coverage, finding work, and later unit modules.

nodes.title: Dispatch bounded work
nodes.role: Prepare the task workspace and provider lane. Send the task objective with its conversation iteration limit.

nodes.title: Poll active conversations
nodes.role: Read active worker status. Ingest available events and structured files while a conversation remains active.

nodes.title: Retain evidence and decide
nodes.role: Classify terminal results, parse output, check submission identity, and retain useful observations before outcome handling. Completion and retry use their own checks.

nodes.title: Refresh shared records
nodes.role: Update determinations and applicable report state. Report and visualization workers have their own cadence and slot rules.

nodes.title: Save and continue or return
nodes.role: Persist active conversations and coordinator state. Module completion has a separate progress store. Continue when configured and eligible; idle, stalls, or limits can return control.

flows.title: Passes on one target
flows.summary: Example security-pack path. Unit dependencies are local to that unit. Finding verification targets finding records; review does not have to produce a finding.

nodes.title: Characterize a unit
nodes.role: Default security assessment pulls in characterization through its dependencies. Explicit baseline selection supports characterization-only work.

nodes.title: Map its attack surface
nodes.role: The security reconnaissance module follows characterization on the same target. Identify inputs, parsers, privileges, and trust boundaries.

nodes.title: Review concrete risks
nodes.role: The security review module follows reconnaissance for that unit. Retain source evidence and candidate findings through the corresponding persistence paths.

nodes.title: Select finding verification
nodes.role: When an eligible finding exists and finding work is selected, the security verification module receives that finding as its target.

nodes.title: Record an evidence-backed decision
nodes.role: Promotion and disposition use their own evidence and receipt checks. Accepted and refused decisions remain available to later work and closeout.

flows.title: The resource feedback cycle
flows.summary: Tool delivery is a recorded resource workflow. Head cycles reread delivered items; compatibility research drivers load them at startup. The standing scheduler selects its own work queues.

nodes.title: Record a resource need
nodes.role: Create an open wishlist item with its kind, item, reason, and requester. Access and data needs can remain for operator handling.

nodes.title: Check host availability
nodes.role: The watchdog reads open and provided records. It skips matching provided tools and checks the host executable path for supported request kinds.

nodes.title: Provide a supported tool
nodes.role: An already available executable can be recorded as provided. When enabled, a fixed allowlisted installer can supply a missing tool; success must pass an executable check. Unhandled requests remain visible.

nodes.title: Record delivery and its receipt
nodes.role: Append a new provided row and an ops-event ledger receipt linking the source request and delivery. The original request remains in history.

nodes.title: Brief later workers
nodes.role: Each head cycle reads provided items. The research driver and three binary drivers include their startup snapshot in worker objectives, with instructions to avoid duplicate requests.

nodes.title: Continue authorized research
nodes.role: Use resources in the appropriate host or worker environment. Resolve related obligations and obtain any required action grants through their separate APIs. A later need can create another wish.

flows.title: From operator intent to bounded work
flows.summary: The normal workbench lifecycle reaches one authorized backend launch path and a persistent scheduler.

steps.title: Create the subject
steps.detail: Attach the source path to a subject workbench with its own research state.

steps.title: Compile shared context
steps.detail: Generate a briefing from selected source material, metadata, workbench text, and operator direction.

steps.title: Select work and scope
steps.detail: Choose packs, custom modules, path rules, scope constraints, and optional threat-model work.

steps.title: Check readiness
steps.detail: Inspect providers, services, paths, capabilities, and remaining work through Doctor and Estimate.

steps.title: Authorize launch
steps.detail: Compare the process request and subject path with a grant. Refusal blocks backend launch. Grant authentication activates with the configured operator token.

steps.title: Prepare the execution workspace
steps.detail: Reuse the source mount or copy its snapshot. Create separate writable task scratch.

steps.title: Inventory the material
steps.detail: Record file identity and establish coverage units; request a plan for binary-only intake.

steps.title: Choose the next target
steps.detail: Prioritize obligations and subject setup. Claim fresh breadth directly before eligible finding work and later unit passes.

steps.title: Build the task contract
steps.detail: Combine context, scope, shared notes, the selected target, module intent, and required outputs.

steps.title: Dispatch a specialist
steps.detail: Start the configured conversation with its lane, workspace, objective, and iteration limit.

flows.title: From worker output to reviewable evidence
flows.summary: Observations are captured independently of whether the worker can complete its assignment.

steps.title: Read active messages
steps.detail: Collect agent-authored message and action text from persisted conversation events.

steps.title: Read saved results
steps.detail: Merge structured submissions from the workspace and register useful analysis files.

steps.title: Normalize the result
steps.detail: Parse typed envelopes and supported facts, leads, findings, flows, and determination fields.

steps.title: Prevent repeated ingestion
steps.detail: Use stable observation keys and persistent submission identities across live and terminal paths.

steps.title: Store canonical evidence
steps.detail: Append ledger records and preserve finding locations, artifacts, and scheduler inputs.

steps.title: Evaluate completion separately
steps.detail: Classify the invocation, parse output, and check submission identity. Preserve observations before handling success, scheduling repair, or creating obligations.

steps.title: Retain unfinished obligations
steps.detail: Create pending actions for failed output, missing proof, access requests, or empty subject passes.

steps.title: Validate the candidate
steps.detail: Check evidence, confidence, source membership, scope, and claimed verification material.

steps.title: Record the disposition
steps.detail: Require the appropriate receipt for promotion, suppression, duplicates, deferral, and quality changes.

steps.title: Archive before retirement
steps.detail: Save trajectory and event records before conversation cleanup.

flows.title: Adapt one campaign to its subject
flows.summary: Work declarations connect broad examination with focused research without a global phase counter.

steps.title: Select the target family
steps.detail: Use the whole subject, coverage units, or findings as the work source.

steps.title: Compose packs
steps.detail: Combine characterization, reverse engineering, security, research, development, or analysis packs.

steps.title: Add local questions
steps.detail: Declare a custom module with its task class and bounded objective.

steps.title: Constrain expensive work
steps.detail: Apply path globs to later unit passes and module concurrency limits to subject, finding, and later unit selection.

steps.title: Resolve prerequisites
steps.detail: Add built-in dependencies and reject unknown or cyclic module relationships.

steps.title: Establish breadth
steps.detail: Claim fresh coverage units directly and dispatch characterization under the global concurrency limit.

steps.title: Reuse earlier results
steps.detail: Supply prior summaries, findings, shared notes, and artifacts to follow-on passes.

steps.title: Challenge findings
steps.detail: Dispatch finding-specific verification or patch work when eligible.

steps.title: Select required tools
steps.detail: Install and start supporting analysis resources only for the subject work that needs them.

steps.title: Persist target progress
steps.detail: Save completed module identifiers and known targets so later execution continues from the same state.

flows.title: From long-running research to checked publication
flows.summary: Persistent execution state and report state preserve both the work and the conditions for accepting it.

steps.title: Record run identity
steps.detail: Store active conversations, source identities, lane configuration, stage state, and checkpoints.

steps.title: Handle temporary failure
steps.detail: Apply transport retry or classified worker repair within the configured limits.

steps.title: Escalate unresolved conditions
steps.detail: Preserve scope, capability, exhausted retry, or recovery decisions as visible obligations.

steps.title: Check resumed inputs
steps.detail: Compare checkpoint hashes before continuing active work.

steps.title: Compile developing understanding
steps.detail: Update determinations, evidence counts, the living report, and analyst notes.

steps.title: Enrich from evidence
steps.detail: Group facts, retain related locations, and include runtime proof and decision records.

steps.title: Protect the current report
steps.detail: Compare populated sections before replacing the selected report object.

steps.title: Refresh the authoritative draft
steps.detail: Include evidence written during enrichment before evaluating publication freshness.

steps.title: Evaluate completion
steps.detail: Inspect blocking obligations, validation, receipts, claims, context, and report freshness.

steps.title: Record the accepted outcome
steps.detail: Resolve barriers or record explicit override receipts, then preserve the closeout decision.

useCases.title: Source security research
useCases.description: Combine measured source examination with attack-surface review, candidate findings, verification, and remediation work.
useCases.outcome: A reviewable evidence trail, explicit unresolved work, and findings linked to source and reproduction material.

useCases.title: Reverse engineering and architecture mapping
useCases.description: Accumulate component determinations, interface observations, flow relationships, saved analysis, and a technical narrative.
useCases.outcome: A persistent codex that later workers can extend without repeating the entire examination.

useCases.title: Compiled-binary investigations
useCases.description: Use the standalone binary family to seed function questions, examine decompilation, challenge claims, and collect runtime proof.
useCases.outcome: Function-anchored research, explicit validation blockers, and reproducible finding packages when proof is available.

useCases.title: Long research campaigns
useCases.description: Coordinate bounded specialist work across interrupted execution, provider changes, unresolved decisions, and repeated report revisions.
useCases.outcome: Resumable subject state with archived evidence, current analyst notes, and an inspectable closeout decision.

controlSummary: REFALL controls campaign resources, brokered launch decisions, scheduled work, and evidence acceptance. Runtime mounts and tool permissions supply the execution boundary. Recorded receipts keep scope decisions and completion reviewable.

controlLayers.title: Source and workspace projection
controlLayers.boundary: Host source directory to the configured Agent Canvas container.
controlLayers.mechanism: Resolve the source directory, validate the subject name, inspect the container, and reuse its matching mount or copy source files.
controlLayers.prevents: Invalid source directories, unsafe subject names, and failed projection cannot complete this synchronization route.
controlLayers.activation: Backend launch supplies an available source path. Existing Docker mounts retain their configured access mode.
controlLayers.attempt: Project a missing source directory or an unsafe subject name.
controlLayers.decision: Synchronization raises AgentWorkspaceError. A copied directory remains an ordinary container directory.

controlLayers.title: Content identity and source observations
controlLayers.boundary: Configured source root to the campaign inventory.
controlLayers.mechanism: Hash file content and record relative paths, file facts, unreadable files, and symlink observations.
controlLayers.prevents: No worker operation is blocked by inventory collection. Membership supports later finding checks.
controlLayers.activation: Inventory enumeration runs for source intake or an explicit inventory refresh.
controlLayers.attempt: A file symlink resolves outside the source root.
controlLayers.decision: Record an off-root observation. File facts can still read the resolved file.

controlLayers.title: Authenticated capability changes
controlLayers.boundary: Capability grant and revoke HTTP routes.
controlLayers.mechanism: Compare X-REFALL-Operator-Token with the configured token file. Replace the supplied grantor with operator after authentication.
controlLayers.prevents: Unauthenticated grant or revoke requests are refused when token protection is configured.
controlLayers.activation: Set REFALL_CAPABILITY_OPERATOR_TOKEN_PATH to a readable token file. The default unset value disables token authentication and retains caller-supplied grantor identity.
controlLayers.attempt: Submit a grant without the configured operator token.
controlLayers.decision: HTTP 403; no grant is stored. An unreadable credential file gives HTTP 503.

controlLayers.title: Scoped authorization decisions
controlLayers.boundary: An action request presented to the capability broker.
controlLayers.mechanism: Require a class and declared effects. Match an active grant against applicable target and effect conditions.
controlLayers.prevents: Requests with no matching unexpired grant receive a refusal decision.
controlLayers.activation: Call /execution/authorize or use a backend caller that consults the store. Scope checks depend on populated request and grant fields.
controlLayers.attempt: Request a host, method, or path outside the configured grant.
controlLayers.decision: Return accepted:false with refusal reasons and record the API decision. This decision-only route launches no command; callers must obey refusal.

controlLayers.title: Backend process release
controlLayers.boundary: Named Start or Update command to the standing-loop process.
controlLayers.mechanism: Apply operation switches and the command allowlist. Authorize the subject-path run_local_command request before launch.
controlLayers.prevents: A refused capability decision prevents this backend route from starting the loop process.
controlLayers.activation: Enable REFALL_ENABLE_OPS and REFALL_ENABLE_OPS_COMMANDS; both default false. Loop launch defaults true. Disabled launch skips authorization and starts no process.
controlLayers.attempt: Start a subject without a matching process grant.
controlLayers.decision: HTTP 403 before process launch. Start without stored context returns HTTP 409.

controlLayers.title: Work selection and claim allocation
controlLayers.boundary: Stored work to a scheduled subject, unit, or finding assignment.
controlLayers.mechanism: Prioritize obligations, subject setup, fresh breadth, finding work, and later unit passes. Use claims and per-target progress.
controlLayers.prevents: Eligible selection branches skip modules with unmet dependencies, completed target work, duplicate active target work, matching exclusions, or exhausted module slots.
controlLayers.activation: Standing-loop selection applies branch-specific conditions. Fresh breadth bypasses module eligibility; later unit selection omits unit_state. Global concurrency still applies.
controlLayers.attempt: A later unit pass does not match its path filter or has an unmet dependency.
controlLayers.decision: Skip that pass. Fresh characterization uses direct coverage claims and the global conversation limit.

controlLayers.title: Conversation and recovery bounds
controlLayers.boundary: A scheduled assignment to the Agent Canvas conversation API.
controlLayers.mechanism: Send the task workspace, provider settings, objective, and max_iterations. Classify failures before bounded retry.
controlLayers.prevents: Recognized scope, capability, and operator-stop outcomes do not receive ordinary automatic worker retries.
controlLayers.activation: The normal dispatcher sends conversation limits to Agent Canvas. Fresh characterization requests 30 iterations; recoverable worker retries default to two attempts.
controlLayers.attempt: A worker reports scope_blocked or capability_missing.
controlLayers.decision: Preserve available output and create an operator or capability obligation instead of repeating the action.

controlLayers.title: Scope and workspace instructions
controlLayers.boundary: Campaign context to specialist reasoning and tool choice.
controlLayers.mechanism: Build an objective from stored context, scope, target, module, routing, output requirements, source location, and scratch location.
controlLayers.prevents: These instructions request in-scope behavior. They do not mechanically prevent external tool actions.
controlLayers.activation: The dispatcher constructs the specialist initial message.
controlLayers.attempt: An assignment identifies source as read-only and provides a scratch directory.
controlLayers.decision: The worker receives explicit writing instructions. Actual write permissions come from mounts and process access.

controlLayers.title: Continuation input comparison
controlLayers.boundary: A checkpointed campaign to a resumed standing loop.
controlLayers.mechanism: Compare recorded input hashes with current source and configuration hashes through resume preflight.
controlLayers.prevents: A returned drift refusal stops the supported resume path and exposes a decision obligation.
controlLayers.activation: Prior checkpoints and the preflight API are available. Missing optional support and some service errors bypass refusal.
controlLayers.decision: Record resume_preflight_refused and stop that continuation path.

controlLayers.title: Continuous result capture
controlLayers.boundary: Worker events and workspace results to persistent campaign evidence.
controlLayers.mechanism: Read conversation events and submission files during execution. Terminal handling classifies, parses, checks identity, and preserves observations before handling the classified outcome.
controlLayers.prevents: Observation itself does not stop the worker action that produced a result.
controlLayers.activation: Standing-loop polling and completion run ingestion. Structured terminal submission remains optional unless REFALL_REQUIRE_STRUCTURED_SUBMIT is enabled.
controlLayers.attempt: A worker fails after it produced useful facts or artifacts.
controlLayers.decision: Preserve available output, classify the failure, and expose repair or operator work.

controlLayers.title: Finding admission and declared scope
controlLayers.boundary: A proposed finding to canonical finding storage.
controlLayers.mechanism: Require evidence, confidence, and source or artifact references. Check available inventory membership and explicit external-target scope.
controlLayers.prevents: Unsupported or out-of-scope candidates are refused admission to the finding store.
controlLayers.activation: add_finding evaluates a proposed record after worker activity. Inventory membership is advisory when inventory is unavailable; external URL hosts require explicit scope.
controlLayers.attempt: A candidate cites https://outside.example.test without that host in explicit external_targets.
controlLayers.decision: Refuse promotion. The API records the refusal and creates review work.

controlLayers.title: Typed finding transitions
controlLayers.boundary: Existing finding state to a new status or quality tier.
controlLayers.mechanism: Check current status, allowed states, receipt types, evidence references, pending contradictions, and supplied source hashes.
controlLayers.prevents: A refused transition preserves the existing finding state and records the refused attempt.
controlLayers.activation: The transition path receives a proposed decision. Hash freshness checks activate when the receipt supplies source or configuration hashes.
controlLayers.attempt: Mark a finding FALSE_POSITIVE without an accepted receipt type and evidence.
controlLayers.decision: Refuse the transition. Live validation, duplicate, downgrade, and chain deferral have separate receipt requirements.

controlLayers.title: Persistent resolution obligations
controlLayers.boundary: Open or claimed pending work to a terminal resolution.
controlLayers.mechanism: Keep missing access, blocked scope, incomplete evidence, and refused decisions in pending records. Validate required resolution receipts.
controlLayers.prevents: Required receipt failures prevent pending-action resolution; open obligations can block closeout.
controlLayers.activation: Resolve, defer, or cancel a pending action. Required types vary by action; an untyped done action does not universally require evidence.
controlLayers.attempt: Defer an obligation without evidence references.
controlLayers.decision: Reject the resolution. Required receipt types must match and include evidence.

controlLayers.title: Report replacement protection
controlLayers.boundary: Enriched report content to the current report object.
controlLayers.mechanism: Compare populated report sections before replacing the current formal report. Retain a refused candidate as a diagnostic object.
controlLayers.prevents: An unapproved structural downgrade cannot replace the current report through this assembly path.
controlLayers.activation: assemble_report defaults allow_structural_downgrade to false. Explicit override bypasses this guard. Generic object writes use a separate API path.
controlLayers.attempt: Replace a rich report with a candidate that loses protected sections.
controlLayers.decision: Return downgrade_refused and keep the current report.

controlLayers.title: Campaign closeout acceptance
controlLayers.boundary: Current campaign records to a closed lifecycle result.
controlLayers.mechanism: Check pending actions, receipts, refused transitions, finding proof, expired claims, context, and report freshness.
controlLayers.prevents: Blocking failures prevent a successful closed result from the closeout operation.
controlLayers.activation: Named Closeout or the loop manager evaluates the gate. Draft/current reports can already exist; this gate controls the closed lifecycle result.
controlLayers.attempt: Close a campaign with open pending work or a stale report.
controlLayers.decision: Return blocked and record loop.closeout.blocked. Coverage below 95 percent is advisory.

controlLayers.title: Recorded closeout exceptions
controlLayers.boundary: A declared operator exception to selected closeout checks.
controlLayers.mechanism: Require check IDs and a nonempty receipt. Append an accepted override entry and make matching failed checks nonblocking warnings.
controlLayers.prevents: Missing check IDs or receipt prevent this override route from accepting the exception.
controlLayers.activation: The override route receives an explicit decision record. It records the supplied operator name without capability-token authentication; deployment access control establishes caller authority.
